violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. EHS scheduled follow to verify CFM present during operation. EHS will follow up in 2 weeks to confirm additional food employee has taken the food safety exam and obtained the food certification.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: kitchen equipment and utensils cleaned and sanitized in chlorine sanitizer solution dish machine with 0ppm concentration at the time of inspection. The lines connecting the buckets of (chlorine sanitizer and degreaser rinse aid) were not attached to the dishmachine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: PIC agreed to discontinue using the chlorine sanitizer dish machine until lines from the chlorine sanitizer and degreaser rinse aid are correctly attached. PIC will use quat sanitizer solution at 3 vat sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize kitchen equipment and utensils until dish machine is repaired.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: EHS observed black mold like debris on the interior and not being cleaned as required inside the ice machine in the back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CDI: PIC agreed cleaned the interior of the ice machine in the back main kitchen area.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution dish machine and quat sanitizer solution (3 vat sink) in the back main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. EHS scheduled follow up to verify chlorine and quat sanitizer solution test strips.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: kitchen equipment and utensils being cleaned inside chlorine dishmachine with 0ppm concentration in the back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: EHS ran chlorine dishmachine machine several times and 0ppm was final reading. CFM not available during inspection to assist with adjusting dish machine. EHS instructed CFM to use quat sanitizer at 3 compartment sink until chlorine dishmachine is serviced or reads at least 150ppm per manufacturer instructions.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: housemade whipped herb butter in unlabeled metal container stored in Motak 2 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM labeled the housemade whipped herb butter with remaining hold date (6 days remaining).

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Fruit flies harborage conditions exist in the middle floor drain in the back kitchen area. Observed multiple flies in throughout the back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. EHS instructed CFM to schedule additional treatment to address fruit flies in floor drain. CFM provided recent pest control service invoice (monthly treatment Green Pest).

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed two ice bins on top of the ice machine in the back kitchen area that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM inverted both of the ice binds on top of clean contact surface. QAMARIA YEMENI COFFEE (Inspection Date: 04/20/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): stored food off the floor in the back kitchen near UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS instructed to remove the milk crates from the kitchen prep area and store food items to shelf that will allow for proper cleaning.
